Here’s a clearer version with tightened wording and structure:

---

The trade replay issue—where ‘REPL’ is reported to TRAX instead of ‘NEWM’ for active trades (i.e. trades not yet archived in CMRS)—was introduced by RH archiving story 2323911 and is now impacting the #13 fix.

Under the new ESP extract for #13, replay messages are being generated for rebooked trades, which are updated with the original Position Trader details based on OMS trade linkages. However, because these are all replay messages (`<SST_REPLAY> = 'Y'`), RH reports them to TRAX as ‘REPL’.

TRAX will reject all of these #13 replay messages, as the underlying trades were never initially reported to TRAX and therefore have no prior reference. As a result, the #13 replayed trade messages will be rejected in the same way as standard BAU replay messages, meaning the #13 changes in ESP and RH are effectively rendered useless.
